description: Reach the human who owns this call when they are not on the call page: an SMS to their own confirmed number with a single-use link back into this call (valid 10 min, opens only logged in or with the PIN from the SMS); if they do not open it within 2 minutes, a phone call follows. Prefer this over call_me. Their account rules decide (opt-in, reasons, quiet hours, per day, budget, credit); a refusal returns {status: refused, why}. Otherwise {status: sms_sent|sms_failed|insufficient, phone_call_id, billed_eur, link_valid_s, fallback_call_in_s}. reason: done | blocked | decision. message: max 120 characters, in the SMS.

message.description: Optional short text for the SMS, max 120 chars.
message.title: Message

title: Notify the human (SMS first)
